title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Doña Maria D. Tan Memorial Hospital in the City of Tangub, Province of Misamis Occidental, To Ninoy Aquino Memorial Hospital
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Doña Maria D. Tan Memorial Hospital in the City of Tangub, Province of Misamis Occidental, To Ninoy Aquino Memorial Hospital

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1992/ra_7434_1992.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of Doña Maria D. Tan Memorial Hospital in Tangub City, Province of Misamis Occidental, is hereby changed to Ninoy Aquino Memorial Hospital.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: April 23, 1992
